Shortcuts & settings

/Search every page
F M C R TFill blanks · SBA · Recall · Read · 🧠 Think
💡Tap on a line for the reasoning behind it (appears once the line is answered)
1–4Pick an MCQ answer
Enter / →Next question or card
SpaceFlip a recall card / jump to the next drop-down
1–4 on a drop-downPick that option and move on
[ ]Previous / next condition
SStart a sprint
↕ / 🔎 / 🪝In 🧠 Think: predict the arrows, then hunt the stem clue or recall the mnemonic (tap to reveal). Chips filter clues, ⚠️ traps, 🇬🇧 US-vs-UK and 🪝 hooks; HY = Mehlman, FA = First Aid. Full sets live in the Frameworks library tabs.
🔑Clinchers: under every condition title, the finding or lab combination that settles it (✅) or rules it out (❌), plus key 🧪 patterns. Open it once and it stays open.
🔨Hammer SBAs: three single-best-answer questions for every ILO condition, drug group, test and procedure, plus off-map topics and your own mock (🎓). 🔨 classic, 🔨🔨 two steps or a lookalike, 🔨🔨🔨 curveball. Each answer shows why, then 🔄 the flip: the one change that makes another option right. A–E answer, Enter next, Esc leave. Each condition page has its own 🔨 button. 🏛️ Official papers: the 599 MS AKT and MSCAA practice questions (incl. Sept 2026 P1 & P2) with their images, lab tables and examiners' justifications. S 🦅 scan mode lifts the question line, lights out-of-range values and fades normal ones. After each answer, 🧬 examiner pattern links the twins across papers.
🧲Triggers: every condition, bug, drug, investigation and procedure in your ILOs as one line each: the scene, the word that flips it in highlighter, then the answer. One long scroll with a picture on every line. ⌘F filters it, twice for the browser's find; 🔒 L blurs the answers, tap or N to reveal. Each condition's word hunt opens its own triggers.
🗺️Poster: every condition as one picture with the same layout: cause top-left, who top-right, tests on the right, treatment bottom-right, danger bottom-left, the lookalike on the left, signs in the middle, the hook along the bottom. 🔒 Lock or L hides the drugs, numbers and signs: say them, then tap or press N. ▶ Walk it lights the zones in order. In quiz modes the poster starts locked. The 🎞️ Film and 🖼️ Pictures tabs sit beside it; paste your own infographics there and box over the details.
🧭Master posters: one picture for a whole topic, from spirometry to antidotes. The first five rebuild your AI-made infographics, with what was wrong listed under 🔎.
⌘F⌘F or Ctrl+F jumps to the search bar. Press it again there for the browser's own find.
👁️Clinical Atlas Lookup on every condition: DermNet, LITFL, Radiopaedia, Radiology Masterclass and Google Images open in a new tab. 🥊 chips open the visual showdowns (drawn ECGs, X-rays, fundi, eardrums).
📋Paste exam image: on any condition press Ctrl+V / ⌘V (iPad and phone: long-press the paste box → Paste, or 📷 Choose image) to file a question image that tricked you. The vault reviews them with your note hidden.
🎯Blind clincher sniper: a clincher with the disease blacked out. 1–4 name it and pick the first move, Space reveals the trap, M mutates (same presentation, one feature changed).
🔄Remix: answer the question on Passmedicine, copy the page (⌘A, ⌘C), open 🔄 Remix and press ⌘V. Check ✅ and ✋ (📷 adds an image), then the same patient with one clue changed each round: watch which option wins (1–5, Enter, Esc to leave). The end lines up all five: answer ← the clue that picks it. Cards come back tomorrow, then in 3 days, a week and so on, with new variations ready each time (▶ Due today). 🚩 drops one that looks wrong; 🧠 Careful is slower and more accurate.
⚡〰️🌊📈Speed tags: how fast a condition arrives (sudden, comes and goes, fluctuates, gradual). Filter by speed under 🗂 Browse on the home screen.
🎬🟰🏷️Clinchers that hinge on an exam name read as: 🎬 what you see 🟰 🏷️ the exam name (with a 🔗 memory hook) → 🎯 the diagnosis. The sniper hides the 🎯 part until you answer.
🔺Jargon decoder: exam names that don't describe what they are (Δ wave, Wenckebach, Kussmaul, Rinne…). Chips on each condition open them. In the sniper: ① picture → name, ② name → picture, ③ what do you do, or 🔺 all three. Space reveal, 1/2 mark, Enter next.
🗂 / 🆕Systems & presentations (top of the chapter list) filters by system or jumps to any ILO week or framework. 🆕 marks guideline updates next to older rules.
🩺 / 🧬In 🧠 Think: an Oxford case (open one step at a time, then one SBA) and a short Pathoma "why it happens" card. Every case sits under its ILO; all 29 complaints are in the 🩺 Cases library tab.
